title: Lover perks: Pet Health and Good Gifter
summary: Two new Lover perks. Pet Health gives your tamed pets an extra half heart for each rank, with no limit. Good Gifter makes animals easier to win over: every rank makes your gifts tame more often, and as it grows animals start taking similar food, then other animals' food, then your own food, then anything at all, until a friendly hand is enough. Player mobs also warm to your gifts faster.
